title: Deep Dive: Global Energy, AI, and Chevron Analysis
summary: Energy infrastructure, AI demand, and Chevron resilience.
coverage_note: All blocks and chart inventory read. Covered liquidity, labor, Egypt energy/FX, bitcoin/Lightning, securities enforcement, AI power demand, hydrocarbons and portfolio construction.

claims.reason: The trigger occurred. Yen strengthened from ¥160.73/$ on July 5 to ¥141.93 on September 18, but much of this preceded the first Fed cut. framework_lessons: Separate energy volume, infrastructure and investment return.
assessment: The strongest verified calls concern 2024 easing and later regulatory change. Energy-demand direction held in 2025, but slower growth and weaker Chevron profits limit the equity inference. Egypt financing proved more resilient than a simple dollar-shortage narrative. AI demand is genuinely long horizon.

Image labels were inventoried; chart images were not inspected.
No portfolio or equity total returns are inferred from business results.
